kind: Driver window-ownership incident; not product failure
detail: System Events AX PID lookup returned windows from a different concurrently running CFT156 despite own PID filter. One Esc may have reached that browser. No site data was cleared; no process was killed through that path. Exact impact of that Esc is unknown.
correction: Stopped AX/window-title targeting. Native permission input used CoreGraphics window owner PID30891 + exact sheet ID and current bounds, verified frontmost PID and correct mouse down/up event constants.
cleanupScope: resource-cleanup.json otherProcessesSignalled=false describes cleanup signals only; it does not negate the earlier potentially misplaced Esc.
